findings.claim: The project pack appears to address VARA Client VA Safekeeping (Segregation of Client Virtual Assets) (custody). Evidence aligned with the obligation to licensed custody vasps must safekeep client virtual assets separately from firm assets, maintain accurate books of client entitlements, and implement wallet and key-management controls (including cold storage for a material portion of holdings) consistent with the custody services rulebook. Checklist items observed: client-asset segregation policy aligned to the Custody Rulebook; wallet inventory distinguishing firm vs client, hot vs cold; key-ceremony and multi-party control records. Pack excerpt: "Aurum Custody — Confidential Project Pack (White Paper excerpt) AURUM CUSTODY  |  PROJECT PACK v0.9  |  CONFIDENTIAL Target markets: Dubai (VARA) and the Europe…"

Partial coverage of VARA Reserve and Backing Assets (Attestation and Safekeeping of Reserves) (reserve). Observed: reserve composition and vault/custodian schedule; independent attestation (quantity, quality, segregation). Still missing: encumbrance / lien negative confirmation; attestation frequency and public summary. Pack excerpt: "product AURUM-X is presented as a fully reserved, allocated gold token. Marketing copy states that "every token is backed 1:1 by investment-grade gold." The bac…"

Partial coverage of MiCA Art. 75 (custody). Observed: wallet inventory and position register; on-chain segregation or equivalent control evidence. Still missing: written custody and administration policy. present_items: client-asset segregation policy aligned to the Custody Rulebook
wallet inventory distinguishing firm vs client, hot vs cold
daily reconciliation of on-chain balances to the client ledger
gaps.obligation: Licensed Custody VASPs must safekeep client virtual assets separately from firm assets, maintain accurate books of client entitlements, and implement wallet and key-management controls (including cold storage for a material portion of holdings) consistent with the Custody Services Rulebook.

Where a issued virtual asset is represented as backed by commodities or other assets, the issuer must hold matching reserves with an appropriate custodian, prohibit encumbrance that would defeat holder claims, and obtain periodic independent attestation of quantity, quality, and segregation of the backing assets.

present_items: on-chain segregation or equivalent control evidence
gaps.obligation: Providers of custody and administration of crypto-assets on behalf of clients must establish a custody policy, maintain a register of positions, keep client crypto-assets segregated on the distributed ledger or by other equivalent means, and exercise due care over control of cryptographic keys.

missing_items: VA Issuance white paper submitted or prepared for VARA
present_items: description of gold/commodity backing and custodians
gaps.obligation: VA Issuance activity requires a VARA-compliant white paper, ongoing disclosure of material changes, and, for asset-referenced or commodity-linked tokens, a description of backing, custody of backing assets, and redemption mechanics.

missing_items: conflicts-of-interest policy covering issuer-custodian dual role
gaps.obligation: VASPs must identify, manage, and disclose conflicts of interest arising from proprietary activity, related-party dealings, dual roles (for example issuer plus custodian of the same token), and staff personal holdings.

missing_items: incident-response plan with VARA notification triggers
gaps.obligation: VASPs must maintain technology, cyber-security, and operational-resilience controls proportionate to custody and issuance activities, including access management, incident response, penetration testing, and business continuity for wallet infrastructure.

missing_items: MiCA-aligned white paper with required content headings
risk-factor section covering technology, liquidity, and legal risks
notification or publication record for the white paper
gaps.obligation: Offerings of crypto-assets (other than ART/EMT where specific titles apply) require a crypto-asset white paper with fair, clear, and not-misleading information on the issuer, the asset, rights, risks, and the underlying technology. Marketing must be consistent with the white paper.

Persons professionally arranging or executing transactions in crypto-assets must have arrangements to detect and report insider dealing, unlawful disclosure of inside information, and market manipulation. Issuers and CASPs must control inside information and maintain proportionate surveillance.

missing_items: VARA licence (or application) listing each VA Activity
fit-and-proper documentation for controllers and senior managers
compliance-programme description submitted with the application
gaps.obligation: A person must not carry out a VA Activity in Dubai unless licensed by VARA for that specific activity category (for example Custody Services, Broker-Dealer, Exchange, VA Issuance). The licence application must map each product to a VA Activity and demonstrate fitness, propriety, and a viable compliance programme.

missing_items: product disclosure statement / white paper for each token
risk-warning set covering custody and reserve risks
gaps.obligation: Client-facing materials must describe the virtual asset, the VASP's role, material risks (including custody, peg/reserve, and technology risks), fees, and the regulatory status of the product. Disclosures must be kept current and not omit facts that would make them misleading.

missing_items: governance policies approved by the board
gaps.obligation: VASPs must maintain a Dubai-appropriate governance structure with a competent board or equivalent, appointed senior officers (including compliance and MLRO functions), documented policies, and clear reporting lines into the licensed entity.

missing_items: operational process for holder redemption requests
disclosure of fees and conditions of redemption
gaps.obligation: Holders of asset-referenced tokens must have a permanent right of redemption against the issuer at market value of the referenced assets, or by delivery of those assets, under published conditions that are not unduly restrictive.

VASPs must not engage in, and must have controls to detect, market manipulation, wash trading, spoofing, and misuse of inside information. Entities that operate markets or distribute tokens need surveillance, insider lists, and escalation to VARA where required.

missing_items: paid-up capital evidence vs. activity category minima
gaps.obligation: Licensed VASPs must maintain paid-up capital, liquid resources, and professional-indemnity or equivalent insurance at the levels specified for their licensed VA Activities, and report capital adequacy to VARA on the required cycle.

missing_items: independent attestation or audit of reserve holdings
present_items: segregation of reserve from issuer operating funds
gaps.obligation: Issuers of asset-referenced tokens must maintain a reserve of assets that matches the risks and composition of the referenced assets, keep the reserve segregated, and ensure it is not encumbered for the issuer's own obligations. Composition, valuation, and custody of the reserve must be documented.

CASPs must establish and maintain effective, transparent procedures for prompt handling of client complaints, publish those procedures, keep records of complaints and remedies, and ensure clients can file free of charge in an official language of the home Member State or of the client's location.

missing_items: CASP authorisation application or equivalent passporting notice
programme of operations covering each intended crypto-asset service
gaps.obligation: Entities providing crypto-asset services in the Union must obtain CASP authorisation from a competent authority before going live, unless a limited exemption applies. The application must describe the programme of operations, legal form, and intended services (including custody).

missing_items: exit and contingency plans for custody infrastructure
present_items: written agreements with key-management / cloud providers
gaps.obligation: Where a CASP outsources operational functions, it remains fully responsible to clients and competent authorities. Outsourcing must not impair internal control, competent-authority supervision, or the quality of services. Material outsourcing requires due diligence, written agreements, and exit plans.

present_items: consent records if any reuse of client assets is contemplated
gaps.obligation: CASPs that hold client crypto-assets or funds must make adequate arrangements to safeguard ownership rights, keep client assets distinct from the firm's own, and prevent use of client assets for own account except with explicit consent. Funds should be placed with a credit institution or central bank where applicable.

missing_items: client-support channels in English and Arabic as appropriate
gaps.obligation: VASPs must treat clients fairly, provide clear product information, operate an accessible complaints scheme with defined timelines, and keep records of complaints, outcomes, and remediation. Vulnerable-client considerations should be built into onboarding and support.

missing_items: AML/CFT policy and business risk assessment
CDD/KYC playbooks and Travel Rule tooling
gaps.obligation: VASPs must implement a risk-based AML/CFT programme including CDD/KYC, ongoing monitoring, Travel Rule transmission of originator/beneficiary information, sanctions screening, and SAR/STR reporting via the MLRO.

CASPs must have robust governance arrangements, including a clear organisational structure, effective risk-management and internal-control mechanisms, business-continuity plans, and ICT security commensurate with the scale of crypto-asset services.

missing_items: governance chart for the management body
gaps.obligation: CASPs must identify, prevent, manage and disclose conflicts of interest between themselves (including managers, employees and shareholders) and their clients, and among clients. Organisational arrangements and disclosures must be proportionate to the services offered.

missing_items: own-funds calculation vs. minimum capital / overheads
insurance policy if used as a safeguard
gaps.obligation: Authorised CASPs must hold prudential safeguards equal to the higher of a permanent minimum capital amount or a fraction of fixed overheads, in the form of own funds or an equivalent insurance policy covering the territories where services are provided.
